title: Workline capability descriptor v1
description: The cross-cutting contract an Agent Skill declares to become invocable by Workline. Not a design format and not part of the UI Design Package catalog: it says what a capability IS — operations, inputs, outputs, context, interaction, effects, floor, degradations, off policy and retirement — for any capability, design included.

contract_version.description: Version of THIS contract, not of the skill. An unknown value stops validation before any field is read.

name.description: The capability's only public identity. There is no parallel role ID: the binding slot and the capability are one name.

purpose.description: What the capability resolves, in one sentence. Discovery and generated help derive from here rather than restating it.

exposure.description: Routes the capability opens. A skill declaring neither gets no Workline surface — installing a utility does not make it a capability.

default_operation.description: Operation assumed when a caller names none. Null when every invocation must be explicit.

operations.description: The finite operation catalog. Anything outside it is refused, never improvised.

exposure.description: Routes this operation answers on. Always a subset of the capability's own exposure.

workspace.description: Whether the operation needs a resolved Workline root. The CLI treats the invoked directory as an implicit root; a caller without one receives an explicit result and never materializes Workline by reading.

interaction.description: Whether one attempt is the whole conversation, or the operation may answer `needs_input` and continue.

sensitivity.description: Reading a sensitive source is never authorized by the invocation alone.

schema.description: Canonical format id when the input is schema-bearing, else null.

kind.description: A typed value, a durable reference, or both. Host prose is never the payload a flow consumes.

completeness.description: Completeness values this operation may report. A dimension separate from the outcome: `completed` still requires the requested profile's completeness.

effects.description: Every class of effect the operation may exercise. An undeclared effect is never exercised, so `read_only` is a declaration and not the absence of one.

authorization.description: Granted by the invocation itself, or by a preflight the human sees first.

off.description: What binding the capability `off` does to this operation. Never reverted by a host, a wrapper or a legacy name.

floor.description: What runs with nothing installed. A capability a core gate needs carries its own implementation, so a missing external skill never blocks SPEC, PLAN or QUICK.

improvements.description: `host_selected` means the host decides which compatible improvements contribute and in what order; Workline imposes no universal precedence.

degradations.description: The observable reasons a run may fall back, and what each one does. A cause not declared here is not a degradation, it is a failure.

improves.description: What this descriptor improves, in its OWN words. Null when the descriptor IS the capability. Installed never implies compatible: the resolution verifies this claim against the capability being resolved before the improvement contributes or produces any effect.

retired_names.description: Names that are NOT aliases. A binding, invocation or descriptor using one fails with guidance to adopt the live name; it never resolves silently.

retired_formats.description: Formats unsupported as a source: never read, imported, converted or migrated, and unable to satisfy a gate. The files themselves are left intact.
